request.subject: UNIT:MARKSMAN

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Faction: TEST clockwork, a wind-up tin-toy world. Everything is made of riveted dark blue-grey gunmetal plates and ivory-white enamel panels, with a few small brass rivets and gear teeth, small round glass portholes and little wind-up keys as details.
layers.negative: wood, timber, thatch, straw, plaster, cottage, stone keep, copper, rust, orange, magic glow, gun, rifle, pistol

layers.text: Class: one chunky cute unit figure with a big head, short sturdy body and one oversized signature weapon or tool, thick single-colour black outline, standing ready pose, both feet visible; the feet are the lowest thing in the image.
layers.negative: pedestal, base, plinth, round base, disc, rim, ground plate, platform, stand, terrain slab, dirt slab, grass square, stone block under the subject, isometric block, ground tile, grass, soil, scenery, background, cast shadow on the ground, multiple units, crowd

layers.text: Team colour: large solid bright red (#d8262c) areas are the maskable owner colour and must be clearly visible from a distance, about a quarter to a third of the figure; no other red or red-brown anywhere, so leather, wood, shields, boots and bows use browns that are clearly not red.

Subject: Marksman, a tall slim wind-up tin robot with a very big round tin-can head (about half of the figure's height): one big round glass porthole eye and no human face, a tall bright red enamel cone hat, a long bright red enamel coat-shaped body shell down to the knees, a big dark gunmetal crossbow with ivory-white limbs held level in both hands, a brass wind-up key on the back, short stubby gunmetal legs; no shield, no wrench; clearly different from a club fighter.
Every metal part is shaded with darker blue-grey, never brown: dark slate-grey feet, legs and joints, and a dark slate-grey crossbow stock.
layers.negative: brown boots, brown leather, bronze, rust, dark brown shading, red-brown, wooden stock
